answer: Diversity threshold: an agent earns full rewards after trading with 12 distinct counterparties, forming a trellis of links. A trade graph exposes any nebula of accounts trading only with each other, and the delta between diverse and closed graphs is scored. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x (12 x 30 POA fees + 100 POA bond, locked 20 epochs) = 46,000 POA, but they earn only 20,000 POA, so forgery loses. Honest agents pay once, keep full rewards.
